title: ESCALATE: Import validation — validate story_type against types.toml on import

text: {"type":"escalate","finding":"Import validation gap","severity":"Useful","description":"story import writes StoryTypeSet events without validating story_type against types.toml. This means imports can create stories with types that don't exist in the project config. story new and story set both validate eagerly. Doctor catches drift.","pros":"Import stays permissive for migration scenarios","cons":"Inconsistent validation behavior across entry points"}],"recommendation":"Option 2 — import is a bulk/migration tool where strictness may be counterproductive","location":"src/app.rs:761-766"}
{"type":"user_decision","decision":"Option 1: Add validation pass before import. Check each story_type against types.toml before the import loop, fail early with clear message."}
